patch_list: Allow Screenshots & Secure Share - Google Drive (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Removes Android FLAG_SECURE window restrictions in Google Drive to permit taking screenshots and screen recordings of documents, spreadsheets, and presentation previews.
AMOLED Dark Theme & Declutter - Google Drive (Experimental)

⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Forces pure OLED pitch black (#000000) across Google Drive file lists, folder navigation, status bars, and navigation bars, eliminating dark gray tint for maximum OLED power savings.
Unlock View-Only Download & Export Restrictions - Google Drive (Experimental)

⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Bypasses 'Viewers cannot download, print, or copy' restrictions on shared Google Drive files, re-enabling the download, save, print, and export menu actions for protected documents and PDFs.
